prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 34 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1336; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment grew to many times the usual amount for this injury, with near-daily visits and new body areas added weeks after the crash.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented after a side-impact collision at an intersection with shoulder pain. Over 34 visits, care has been far more intensive than is usual for this type of shoulder injury, with near-daily sessions and new body regions added several weeks after the collision. It is not yet clear whether the current complaints stem from this incident. Nearly all reported findings rest on the patient's own descriptions of pain and function, while imaging and orthopedic provocation tests have all returned normal results. No prior injury to the same shoulder is documented in the available records. Billing entries reviewed show no repeated charges for the same service. Ongoing management will focus on symptom monitoring, reassessment of functional goals, and review of causation once additional records are received.
